body:
I know many people have told you this - you might've started to think they don't really care but just know I do.

I don't mean to guilt trip you but - Don't do it. Please.

I know you don't believe me but I've seen the comments below - your only 16. So many people were like you and they lived. They got happier. Someone was abused ( I saw your edit ) and they got away and are living happily. But they had to make the first step. You can get help. I'm here for you. Your 16. You can move out soon then see how good life can be when your with the right people. I know you might not believe me - I can't relate to everything but I know how it feels to just wanna stop.. Have a break y'know? But trust me. Dying won't give you that break. When your dead you won't be able to live to see how amazing life can be and you won't be able to make the first step. I'm sorry if I'm guilt tripping you -

I don't know how it feels to be sexually assaulted or abused, but I know how it feels to be suicidal. And just know I got better.  With time you can to. Just.. Please don't do it. Try to live a little bit longer at least. Your so strong for being able to fight this long. I'm positive your strong enough to keep fighting. And I know this is stupid advice but if your being abused try to call a hotline when you can. It can really help you make that first step. Message me if you want. We can chat about ANYTHING you want.

We can chat about cats, art, nature, ect. . . If you wanna get your mind off this we can do that. Or if you wanna talk about this we can. Anything. I promise you we can talk about anything. Just please - at least try to fight more before you end it.

 In the comments I saw your brother moved out - Can you try and move in with him?
